base_member_text: pi @L71 is the only PARAMETER literal without an _SP kind suffix (default real, then converted); DEG2RAD @L80 = 0.0175 is a truncated pi/180 (0.017453...) — precision relation with pi @L71 is implicit, not stated in the file
audit_member_text: DEG2RAD=0.0175 at L80 is inconsistent with the module's own pi at L71: pi/180 is approximately 0.0174532925, so every direction conversion using DEG2RAD has about 0.267% scale error.

base_member_text: Module-level mutable scratch variables I,J,K,RES @L83 and itmp/tmp sets @L84-L85 are shared across every routine that USEs PARAM (no SAVE statement, no protection) — which routines rely on them is not determinable from this file

SP=SELECTED_REAL_KIND(6,30) @L67 fixes single precision and MPI_SP=MPI_REAL @L68 must stay consistent with it; any double-precision build would need both changed together (cross-line relation L67-L68)

audit_member_text: RHO_AW is documented as air density relative to water and set to 0.0012041 at L77, while the adjacent absolute values RHO_AIR/RHO_WATER at L78-L79 imply 0.00115. The two density representations differ by about 4.7%, so routines choosing one or the other do not share the same air-water ratio.
